adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed repair recovered three peptide identities, six worker-2 activity/toxicity-context rows, nine database-row audits, and corrected mechanism framing; publication-grade remains blocked because exact primary numeric activity values are not locally recoverable.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figure 4/5 support approximate activity/toxicity-context values, but no primary table or source data file was recovered.
Merged database rows report exact EC50/inhibition values, but these remain database annotations unless a primary numeric table is recovered.

materials_exhausted.notes: OA package contained mmc1.doc and figure images; no additional local supplementary spreadsheet/table with exact activity values was present.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows were reconciled to the three primary Table 2 peptide sequences when possible; exact database activity values remain source_conflict rather than source_verified exact primary-source values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered source-located antiviral inhibition and MTT context rows from results text, Figure 4, Figure 5, and methods, marking figure-only values as approximate and not fabricating exact EC50/OD490 values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced automated keyword mechanism placeholders with source-located pAPN binding/entry-interference, TxxF motif hypothesis, and phage immunogenicity context without overclaiming direct structural mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_decision: Non-accepted because exact primary numeric activity values are unrecoverable locally and the open adjudication ticket blocks final approval.
